chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, all from al-Wassa, from Ahmad ibn A'iz, from Abi Khadeejah, from Mu'alla ibn Khunays, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whatever exceeds from the beard beyond the fist, so it is in the Fire.

key_terms.الْقَبْضَة: Fist (used as a unit of measurement)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the length of the beard in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides a definitive metric for the beard, linking physical grooming to spiritual accountability. It underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that adhering to the Prophet's sunnah in appearance is not merely aesthetic but a means of avoiding divine punishment, thereby elevating the beard to a symbol of religious identity and piety.
